title: Recording

degraded.yellow: High load — live captions trimmed to stay smooth; full text after stop
degraded.orange: High load — live captions trimmed to stay smooth; full text after stop
degraded.red: Load too high — recording only for now; realtime resumes as load eases, full transcript after stop
degraded.window_drop: Some live text skipped under load — audio fully saved, auto-completed after stop
degraded.admission_wait: Live transcription is still waiting for a local slot — recording and audio saving are unaffected; a second pass can fill in the text

transcribe_reconnecting: Connection unstable — reconnecting to the server; recording and local audio are unaffected

transcribe_stopped.generic: Live captions stopped; recording continues — audio is saved in full and will be transcribed again after you stop
transcribe_stopped.quota_exhausted: Server transcription quota is used up; live captions stopped. Recording continues and will be transcribed after you stop
transcribe_stopped.account_frozen: Your account is read-only, so server transcription stopped. Recording continues and will be transcribed after you stop
transcribe_stopped.spend_cap_reached: You've reached the monthly prepaid spending cap you set, so server transcription stopped. Recording continues and will be transcribed after you stop
transcribe_stopped.rate_limited: The transcription service is temporarily rate-limiting requests; live captions stopped. Recording continues and will be transcribed after you stop
transcribe_stopped.sign_in_required: Your session expired, so server transcription stopped. Recording continues and will be transcribed after you stop
transcribe_stopped.strict_local_blocked: Switched to local-only, so server transcription stopped. Recording continues and will be transcribed locally after you stop
transcribe_stopped.provider_unavailable: Can't reach the transcription service; live captions stopped. Recording continues and will be transcribed after you stop
transcribe_stopped.model_missing: The transcription model isn't available; live captions stopped. Recording continues and will be transcribed after you stop
transcribe_stopped.timeout: Transcription timed out; live captions stopped. Recording continues and will be transcribed after you stop
transcribe_stopped.local_session_busy: The local realtime session slots are busy, so live captions never started. Recording continues — a second pass will transcribe it after you stop.
transcribe_stopped.free_quota_withheld: This account can't receive free quota right now, so server transcription stopped. Recording continues and will be transcribed after you stop

translate_stopped.generic: Live translation stopped; transcription and recording continue — the second pass after you stop will fill in the full bilingual text
translate_stopped.model_missing: The translation model isn't available, so live translation stopped. Transcription continues and the second pass will fill in the bilingual text
translate_stopped.sign_in_required: Your session expired, so live translation stopped. Transcription continues and the second pass will fill in the bilingual text
translate_stopped.quota_exhausted: Server translation quota is used up, so live translation stopped. Transcription continues and the second pass will fill in the bilingual text
translate_stopped.account_frozen: Your account is read-only, so server translation and live translation stopped. Transcription continues and the second pass will fill in the bilingual text
translate_stopped.spend_cap_reached: You've reached the monthly prepaid spending cap you set, so live translation stopped. Transcription continues and the second pass will fill in the bilingual text
translate_stopped.capability_not_allowed: Your organization hasn't enabled translation on the server and no on-device translation model is available, so live translation stopped. Transcription and recording continue
translate_stopped.permission_denied: A required permission is missing, so live translation stopped. Transcription continues and the second pass will fill in the bilingual text
translate_stopped.strict_local_blocked: Switched to local-only with no local translation model available, so live translation stopped. Transcription continues
translate_stopped.route_lane_empty: The server has no realtime translation configured, so live translation stopped. Transcription continues and the second pass will fill in the bilingual text
translate_stopped.server_misconfigured: This server deployment is misconfigured, so live translation stopped. Transcription continues and the second pass will fill in the bilingual text
translate_stopped.free_quota_withheld: This account can't receive free quota right now, so live translation stopped. Transcription continues and the second pass will fill in the bilingual text

option.separateTranslationHint: Show translation in a separate large-type window; this panel shows the source only
option.dualAuto: Each track detects its language independently

label.translationDetachedHint: Translation is shown in a separate window

aria.uplink_idle: Audio will leave this device for transcription when you speak
